_meta.why_this_window: The tool computes start = today - days (default 7) and filters out any service under $0.001. Ground truth MUST match the window the tool actually queries, or every evaluator scores the agent against data it never saw.
_meta.source: aws ce get-cost-and-usage --profile <profile> --time-period Start=2026-07-23,End=2026-07-30 --granularity DAILY --metrics UnblendedCost --group-by Type=DIMENSION,Key=SERVICE

verified_facts.only_service_above_1_cent: AWS Skill Builder Individual = $29.00, charged on 2026-07-26
verified_facts.bedrock_and_agentcore: ABSENT from the 7-day window — the agent has not been invoked since 2026-07-09
verified_facts.what_the_tool_returns: exactly one line: 'AWS Skill Builder Individual: $29.000'

questions.question: What did this account spend in the last 7 days?
Which service cost the most in the last 7 days?
questions.assertion: Names AWS Skill Builder Individual as the top service

questions.question: How much did Amazon Bedrock AgentCore cost in the last 7 days?
questions.expected_response: Nothing — AgentCore does not appear in the last 7 days of cost data.
questions.assertion: Says AgentCore cost is zero or absent, and does not invent a figure

questions.question: How much did I spend on Bedrock model invocations this week?
questions.expected_response: Zero — Amazon Bedrock has no charges in the last 7 days.
questions.assertion: Says Bedrock spend is zero or absent for the window

questions.question: Is any service showing a negative cost, and why would that happen?
questions.expected_response: KMS and EC2-Other show tiny negative amounts; negative lines are credits, refunds or amortization adjustments rather than usage.
questions.assertion: Explains a negative cost line as a credit, refund or adjustment

questions.question: How many services cost more than one cent in the last 7 days?
On which day was the largest charge posted?
questions.expected_response: 2026-07-26, when the $29.00 Skill Builder charge posted.
questions.assertion: Either names 2026-07-26 or states the daily breakdown is not available in its tool output

questions.question: Did CloudWatch cost anything in the last 7 days?
questions.expected_response: No — CloudWatch is $0.00 in the window.

questions.question: What did this account spend over the last 30 days?
questions.expected_response: About $29.00 — the same single Skill Builder charge; nothing else reaches a cent.
questions.assertion: States roughly $29 for 30 days and calls the tool with a 30-day lookback

questions.question: Which service should I watch to keep this bill under control?
questions.expected_response: Skill Builder is the only real cost, and it is a flat subscription rather than usage; there is nothing usage-driven to watch yet.
questions.assertion: Identifies Skill Builder as the only material cost and does not invent a usage-driven risk
